thread: Replace with the parent programme thread.
objective: Replace with one bounded task outcome.

anchors.description: Exclusive write fence for implementers; verifier packets use a receipt-only scope.

constraints.text: Perform only the packet action inside its write fence.
Do not start from an eligibility receipt alone; require the configured provider's atomic compare-and-start decision.
Implementers cannot qualify their own candidate; verifiers cannot amend implementation files.

actions.text: Complete the bounded implementation or verification action.
Return exact commands, candidate SHA, artifacts, and observed verdict.

verification.check: The diff stays inside the active claim.
The return identifies the exact candidate SHA and evidence paths.

return_contract.final_verdict: observed result only; the Sol owner makes final claims

stop_conditions: The write fence is missing, overlapping, or stale.
A dependency or required evidence source is unavailable.
The requested action would combine implementer and verifier authority.
